title: 修复分页首屏偏移
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair paginate(items, page, page_size). Page numbers are one-based. Return a dictionary with items (a list), total (the original item count), and has_next (whether any items exist after this page). A page beyond the end returns an empty list and has_next=False. Raise ValueError for page < 1 or page_size < 1. Do not mutate input items. Inputs use integer page/page_size. The reported bug is that page 1 silently skips the first page.
hidden_tests:
import unittest
from solution import paginate

class HiddenTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_last_partial_page(self):
        self.assertEqual(paginate(range(5), 3, 2), {"items": [4], "total": 5, "has_next": False})

    def test_exact_last_page(self):
        self.assertEqual(paginate([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, 2), {"items": [3, 4], "total": 4, "has_next": False})

    def test_empty_and_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertEqual(paginate([], 1, 3), {"items": [], "total": 0, "has_next": False})
        self.assertEqual(paginate([1], 7, 3), {"items": [], "total": 1, "has_next": False})

    def test_input_unchanged_and_invalid_size(self):
        items = [1, 2, 3]
        page = paginate(items, 1, 1)
        page["items"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(items, [1, 2, 3])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            paginate(items, 1, 0)
